name: InvGate Asset Management
summary: InvGate Asset Management starts at $1,499 a year for up to 500 IP devices. Pro costs $5 per IP device a year with a $2,500 annual minimum, and Enterprise starts at $12,000 a year. Licensing contract management is included on Pro and Enterprise only.

facts.text: InvGate describes tracking assets from request to retirement, with warranty tracking, maintenance alerts and renewals.
The pricing page includes contracts and warranties on Starter, and adds licensing contract management for tracking licenses, renewal dates and compliance on Pro and Enterprise.
Listed prices are the base subscription list price, exclude taxes and additional fees, and may change without notice.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Contracts and warranties included, licensing contract management not included

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: From $2,500 a year, for 500 to 5,000 IP devices. Adds licensing contract management

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $12,000 a year, up to 1,000,000 IP devices

hiddenCosts: The pricing page states no trial length for Starter and Pro, which offer a free trial link.
